title: Wildflower: New Build, Heated Pool & Dual Masters
description:
Welcome to Wildflower — a brand new luxury home just one mile from Old Town Scottsdale! This five-bedroom, three-bathroom home features split double masters with en-suites, original mural art, and modern designer furnishings throughout. The backyard offers a heated pool with cabo ledge, gas fire pit, covered patio with TV, BBQ, ping pong, and yard games. With a spacious kitchen, separate bar and dining area, and dual washers and dryers, Wildflower is the ultimate group home base!

 The space 
Step into Wildflower — Your Brand New Luxury Retreat Near Old Town Scottsdale!
This stunning new-construction home combines modern luxury with offbeat design and original artwork, creating a truly unique group getaway in one of Scottsdale's most sought-after neighborhoods. Located just one mile from Old Town Scottsdale and conveniently close to ASU campus, Wildflower puts you minutes from world-class dining, vibrant nightlife, championship golf courses, and everything the city has to offer — all from a private, upscale residential setting.

➤ Amenity Highlights 
✅ Large private pool with cabo ledge (heated upon request)
✅ Gas fire pit for cozy desert evenings
✅ Outdoor BBQ for group cookouts
✅ Covered patio with wall-mounted TV
✅ Ping pong table and yard games: cornhole, giant Connect Four, Jenga & more
✅ Original mural art and offbeat modern décor throughout
✅ Split double master suites with en-suite bathrooms on separate levels
✅ Three additional spacious bedrooms sharing a large third bathroom
✅ Sleeping for up to 13 guests across 5 bedrooms
✅ 3 full bathrooms with modern finishes
✅ Premium smart HD TVs throughout with cable access
✅ Spacious kitchen with wrap-around counter seating for 6
✅ Separate bar and dining area seating 8+
✅ Double washers and dryers for guest use
✅ Ample driveway parking

➤ Included Essentials 
Guests at Wildflower enjoy a curated selection of premium amenities designed to make your stay seamless:
✅ Fully stocked kitchen with cookware, utensils, and spices
✅ Keurig coffee maker with complimentary K-Cups
✅ Hotel-quality white linens & plush bath towels
✅ Striped pool towels provided
✅ Organic bath products (shampoo, conditioner, body wash & essentials)
✅ Premium mattresses and luxury bedding throughout
✅ Premium smart TVs with cable in every bedroom and common area
✅ Free laundry — double washers and dryers available

➤ Inside the Home 
Wildflower makes an impression from the moment you step inside. Original mural artwork sets the tone for the home's offbeat modern aesthetic, with thoughtful designer touches in every room. The large open-concept great room provides plenty of space for groups to spread out, while the kitchen offers wrap-around counter seating for six and a generously stocked pantry — perfect for group cooking.
A separate bar and dining area seats eight or more, giving you a dedicated space for meals and socializing beyond the main living area. The split double master suites — each with their own en-suite bathroom — are located on separate levels, offering maximum privacy for couples or families. Three additional bedrooms share a large third bathroom, ensuring comfortable accommodations for everyone. Dual washers and dryers are available for guest use — a huge convenience for longer stays.

➤ The Backyard 
Step outside and discover why you might never want to leave. The brand new pool features a cabo ledge for lounging in the water, and can be heated upon request for year-round swimming. Gather around the gas fire pit as the sun sets, fire up the BBQ, or challenge your group to a ping pong match. The covered patio with a wall-mounted TV provides shaded outdoor entertainment, while yard games and lounge chairs round out a backyard that's built for desert living at its best.

➤ Policies & Additional Information 

 Pool Heating 
Available upon request for a minimum of three days at $285, with additional days at $95/day. The pool heats to a maximum of 86°F. Performance may vary during colder months (below 50°F overnight). Pool heating charges are non-refundable.
 Pets 
Pets are welcome with prior approval. A $100 fee applies per pet. Please disclose breed, size, and number of pets in advance. Pets must stay off furniture and be cleaned up after.
 Parking 
Ample driveway parking is available. Please do not park on the street or block neighbors' access.
 Quiet Hours 
As required by the City of Scottsdale, quiet hours are from 10:00 PM to 7:00 AM. Noise monitoring devices (volume only — no recordings) are used indoors and outdoors to ensure compliance. Guests are responsible for any fines resulting from violations.
 Guest Count 
The number of guests must match the reservation. Unauthorized overnight guests may result in cancellation or additional charges. Please contact the host if your group size changes.
 Check-In / Check-Out 
– Check-in: 4:00 PM 
Early check-in may be available upon request. Early check-in is subject to availability and potential additional fees. Check-ins requested before 12:00 PM are recommended to book the night prior.
– Check-out: 11:00 AM 
Late check-outs must be approved in advance and may incur additional fees. Late check-outs are subject to availability.
 Outside Vendors 
Outside services (e.g., private chefs, event planners) require prior host approval.
 Security Cameras 
For guest safety and property protection, exterior security cameras are in use. No cameras monitor indoor areas.

📄 TPT License #: 21468565 

 Guest access 
Upon confirming your reservation, you will receive a confirmation message/email containing a link to access your check-in instructions. This hyperlink will direct you to your guest portal , where you'll find detailed instructions for accessing the home along with a variety of other important information related to the property, your reservation, and various manuals/guides for features within the home.
Your guest portal also offers a wealth of information, including local recommendations for restaurants and nightlife, suggested group excursions, and exclusive discounts with local restaurants, shops, and third-party providers we've partnered with. Additionally, you can conveniently purchase select add-ons offered to confirmed guests directly from the portal.
If you have any questions or concerns about the portal after your reservation is confirmed, please don't hesitate to reach out. We're happy to assist and ensure you have a seamless experience!

 Other things to note 
A variety of additional services are available to enhance your stay, and we encourage you to explore the featured offers in your guest portal before check-in. For special requests or arrangements prior to your group's arrival, feel free to contact us via email or phone after booking — we're happy to assist!Please note, the pool can be heated for an additional fee. A pool fence is installed for added safety. We still advise practicing caution with children around the pool area.For security purposes, exterior cameras monitor entry and exit points on the property. Additionally, noise monitors are installed to measure decibel levels both inside and outside, ensuring compliance with city regulations. These devices do not record audio.Wishing you happy travels! -ARK Rentals
